Comment.Language: For the Commemoration of Archangel Suriel:

Text.Language: Marenouwst m~Viwt nem Ps/ri: nem piP~neuma e#y#u#: n~tentaio~ n~Couri/l: pimah f~toou n~a~r,/a~ggeloc.
Let worship the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit, and honor Suriel the fourth in archangels.
فلنسجد للآب والابن والروح القدس ونكرم سوريال الرابع في رؤساء الملائكة.
